## FileNym Core Principles

Please confirm that this contribution has considered the relevant FileNym principles:

- [ ] The canonical file remains the source of truth.
- [ ] The original file is not unnecessarily modified.
- [ ] File content duplication is avoided wherever technically possible.
- [ ] Security and permission implications have been considered.
- [ ] Core functionality does not introduce an unnecessary cloud dependency.
- [ ] The change does not prematurely commit FileNym to an architecture that has not been agreed upon.

Mark only the items relevant to this Pull Request.
